# Fountains USA

> > FountainsUSA is an authorized online retailer of outdoor water fountains and garden water features with free shipping across the continental USA.

Fountains USA specializes in curated collections of outdoor and indoor fountains from trusted manufacturers including WATNATURE, Phoenix Precast, Gist Decor, and Giannani. The company offers comprehensive warranty coverage, secure shopping guarantees, and nationwide shipping via UPS, USPS, and FedEx.
